description: This file defines the build and installation process for the Nginx web server within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded environment, including configuration options, dependencies, patches, and runtime setup.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment for Nginx, setting compilation flags, paths, and modules.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Handles the installation of Nginx including setup of configuration files, init scripts, directories, and symbolic links.

methods.name: pkg_postinst:${PN}
methods.description: Performs post-installation setup such as creating necessary directories or temporary files.
